description: Escape hatch: run 'pac <args...>' directly. Read-only commands (list/who/status/help) run immediately; anything else needs confirm: true. 'profile' runs it as another pac auth profile, for example the tenant admin account.

confirm.description: Required to actually perform a change in a live environment. Without it the tool returns a dry run.

profile.description: pac auth profile to run as (cs_init lists them)

name: cs_pac
title: Run any pac command
